annotations.title: Buy Neumann credits with your saved card

description: Buys Neumann credits by charging the payment card already saved on your account. Credits pay for runs once the free runs for the day are used up, or for a model too large to run free. Use this when an account is low on credits and the user has agreed to the purchase; to see the balance and the live price first, call check_account_and_credits. No saved card is needed to call it: if none is saved yet, it buys nothing and charges nothing: it returns payment_status checkout_required and a checkout_url, which the user opens in a browser to save a card before you call this tool again. It returns the credits bought, the new balance, the payment status and, when a card is needed, the checkout_url. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Buying credits needs the neumann:billing scope when you are signed in rather than using a key. Cost: charges the payment card saved on your account for each credit, currently $0.50 per credit (check_account_and_credits shows the live price). It needs an account, and credits are what a run costs once your free runs for the day are gone -- 1 credit for a small run or 5 for a large one.
